cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/dbg.py <<'EOF'
import random, sys, signal, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from protocol import validate
import gen as G
import te.session as S

rng=random.Random(5000)
req=G.gen_request(rng,big=True)
case=req['cases'][1]
print("events",len(case['events']),"coms",len(case['commodities']),"workers",len(case['workers']),"edges",len(case['edges']),flush=True)

def handler(signum, frame):
    import traceback
    traceback.print_stack(frame)
    sys.exit(1)
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, handler)

class R(S.CaseReplay):
    def run(self):
        for ev in self.case['events']:
            print("  ev", ev['op'], str(ev)[:90], flush=True)
            signal.alarm(6)
            op = ev['op']
            fn = getattr(self, '_' + op if op != 'audit' else '_audit')
            self.results.append(fn(ev))
            signal.alarm(0)
        return {"events": self.results}

S.run_case = lambda c: R(c).run()
resp = S.run_case(case)
print("done")
EOF
